main_text.p: עֲשׂוּיָה facta, עֲשׂוּיִים fa-cti, עֲשׂוּיוֹת factæ, Part. Pahul, Kal, f. & pl. m. & f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עַשׂ fac, pro עֲשֵׂה, Imper. Kal, f. f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עֹשִׂים, עֹשֶׂיךָ facientes tui, עֹשֵׂיהֶם ipsorum, עֹשֶׂיךָ tui, עֹשׂוֹת facien-tes, Part. Ben. Kal, pl. m. aff. & pl. fæm. à f. m. עָשָׂה, & fæm. עֲשָׂה, Rad. עָשָׂה.
עָשִׂיתָ, עָשִׂית fecisti, עָשִׂיתִי feci, עָשִׂינוּ fecimus, עֲשִׂיתֶם fecistis, præt. Kal, 2. f. m. & f. 1. f. & pl. ut & 2. pl. m. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עָשִׂיתִי feci, Ez. 16.59. pro עָשִׂיתִי, præt. Kal, 1. f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עָשִׂיתִי factus sum, præt. Pual, 1. f. R. עָשָׂה.
עֲשִׂיתֶם feciëos, Gen. 6.7. pro עֲשִׂיתֶם, præt. Kal, 1. f. aff. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עָשָׂה fecit te, עָשָׂנוּ nos, præt. Kal, 3. f. m. aff. Rad. עָשָׂה.
עֹשֵׂנוּ factor noster, Ben. Kal, f. m. aff. R. עָשָׂה.
עָשָׂתְ fecit, Lev. 25. 21, pro עֲשָׂתָה, præt. Kal, 3. f. f. Rad. עָשָׂה.
לַעֲשׂוֹת facere, לַעֲשׂוֹת ad faciendum, לַעֲשׂתָה illam, לַעֲשׂתְכֶם vos, Inf. fin. Kal, præf. aff. R. עָשָׂה.
עָשְׂתוּ nitidi sunt, præt. Kal, 3. pl. Rad. עָשַׂת; unde etiam, עֹשֶׂת nitidum, עָשָׂת nitor, No. f. m. à Rad. עֶשֶׂת nitidum esse.
עַשְׂתִּי unus, No. f. m. עַשְׂתּוּת cogitatio, No. f. f. & עַשְׂתֹּנוֹת cogitationes, No. pl. f. R. עַשְׂתּ.
עֵת tempus, עֶתָם ejus, עִתְּךָ tua, עִתּוֹת tempora, לְעֵתוֹת temporibus, עֵתִי[?]

page.notes: The Hebrew vowel points and some letters are blurred by print damage and ink spread, especially in the first lines of both columns and in the last entry of the right column. Readings marked [?] are doubtful. The page number "356" at top left is partly smudged. The running head is Hebrew and partly illegible at the right. The section letter "ע ת" is centred in the right column; the final Hebrew word is cut off at the foot of the scan. Two entries carry a strikethrough-like mark over "3. fem." which may be a stain.
